abstract: Agentic instructions for using the WaaP wallet CLI (waap-cli). Instructs AI agents on how to securely create, manage, sign, and broadcast transactions on EVM and Sui chains without handling raw private keys. Covers commands like signup, login, whoami (dual EVM + Sui address), send-tx (EVM transfers, Sui MIST transfers, and Sui Programmable Transaction Blocks), sign-message, sign-typed-data, sign-tx, policy/2FA, and EIP-1193 RPC requests.
